_note: Pack trees (#287): detailed trees of the private nature pack (assets-private/synty/glb/nature) within near_m of the player in place of the baked box/pyramid trees. Without the pack, with DRYCASTLE_PACK_TREES=0, or on a map whose trees.json lacks model.base_uv2, nothing changes. A tree's base point inside near_m is a pack tree and outside it a baked one (cut in the shaders, global parameter tree_cut); over the last fade_m inside near_m both are drawn, dithered against each other. tile_m: the pack trees are merged into one mesh per tile and material (a tile costs one draw per material; smaller tiles cull better, bigger ones draw less and take longer to build). ahead_m: tiles are built this far past near_m, and freed 2 * ahead_m past it. max_in_flight: tiles being built on worker threads at once. budget_ms: what handing finished tiles to the renderer may take per frame (one surface at least). scale_min / scale_max: a tree is scaled to the height of the code-built tree; a model is chosen among those whose scale lies within this span (the nearest one when none does). bulk_share: the share of trees that take a bulk model (single material, the shared atlas: they merge into one draw per tile); the others take an occasional model (own leaf textures, more draws). shadows: whether pack trees cast shadows themselves; off, the baked tree in the same place casts the sun shadow for them (on roughly doubled the draw calls of a view). shapes: the models that stand in for the tree shapes of trees.json (cone, box), by name in nature/manifest.json, chosen by a hash of the tree's position in proportion to weight; bulk marks a bulk model; a name the pack does not have is skipped. ground_objects: the pack model per kind of ground_objects.json (log, stump, boulder, rootplate), chosen by a hash of the object's position in proportion to weight, scaled so the model's horizontal radius is radius_m times the object's scale (radius_m is the code-built radius at scale 1; the file's model.kinds.KIND.radius_m wins); a log is stretched along the model's Z to its len; yaw_deg is added to rot (the pack log lies along Z; check it against the code-built log's axis). The baked objects are cut by the shared UV2 base, so every kind of the file needs a model here or its baked objects vanish inside the radius. undergrowth: client-only clutter on the forest floor (meadow.bin cells whose zone mix is forest_mix), generated on the worker per tile from a hash of the 2 m cell, no collision, no shadows, gone beyond near_m (dithered like the trees). Per kind: per_100m2 expected pieces on forest floor, scale_min/max, clump (0 even .. 1 patches with gaps), foot (density factor at a trunk, falling to 1 at foot_m), models by weight. tris_per_tile: over it the scatter is thinned (hash order, all kinds alike). trunk_clear_m: nothing within this times the tree's scale of a trunk. clump_m: lattice of the clump noise. Models that wear the Plants atlas material (ferns, bushes, grass, tinted colour) add one material, so one draw per tile; all others share the atlas draw of the bulk trees.
